name: xPand
author: Chai Chaimee
description: xPand is a lightweight text-expansion add-on for NVDA that lets you define short codes for longer phrases. It features instant code expansion across diverse text editors and web browsers, smart editable field detection, a local settings manager with quick search, and automatic configuration storage with seamless legacy migration. Hot Keys: CTRL+F3 Single Tap : Open xPand AutoCorrect Double Tap : Open xPand Settings
